key: Give full measure and full weight, in justice. We task not any soul beyond its scope.
s: Within the sacred duties the Prophet is told to recite, dealings in trade follow the orphan’s wealth; al-Tabari, on 6:152, reads ‘beyond its scope’ as asking no payer for more than the due, and no payee to settle for less.

evidence.words: فإنه يقول: لا نكلف نفسًا، من إيفاء الكيل والوزن، إلا ما يسعها فيحلّ لها ولا تحرَجُ فيه. وذلك أن الله جل ثناؤه، علم من عباده أن كثيرًا منهم تَضيق نفسه عن أن تطيب لغيره بما لا يجبُ عليها له، فأمر المعطي بإيفاء رب الحق حقَّه الذي هو له، ولم يكلِّفه الزيادة، لما في الزيادة عليه من ضيق نفسه بها. وأمر الذي له الحق، بأخذ حقه، ولم يكلفه الرضا بأقل منه، لما في النقصان عنه من ضيق نفسه.
evidence.gloss: He is saying: We charge no soul, in giving full measure and weight, with more than it can bear, so that it is lawful for it and it is not straitened in it. For God knew of His servants that many of them are too narrow of soul to give willingly to another what they do not owe him; so He commanded the one who pays to give the owner of the right the right that is his, and did not charge him with more, because more would straiten his soul; and He commanded the one owed to take his right, and did not charge him with being content with less, because falling short of it would straiten his soul.
